name: launch-depot
description: Research, prioritize, prepare, and run high-signal product submissions across launch directories, design galleries, and editorial discovery channels.

interface.shortDescription: Research and run high-signal product submissions
interface.longDescription: Build a verified distribution plan, prepare product copy and assets, submit only to relevant platforms, and track live placements without fabricating claims, paying, adding badges, or automating community spam.
defaultPrompt: Research relevant launch and directory opportunities for this product and create a prioritized submission plan.
Prepare this website for directory submissions, create the copy kit and tracker, and stop before any paid or identity-sensitive action.
Review my existing submissions and verify which ones are actually live, indexed, and linking back to the site.
